text:
anya: Heads-up — bringing up q8b-int4 variant for franklin today. Want to run a small manual sampling pass against the prompt bank to catch obvious regressions before wider canary. :eyes:
sam: SGTM. What slice do you want to target? longform? code? customer-facing templates?
anya: Focus on: longform summaries, instruction-following, and any prompts with code blocks. Also hit the top 10 intents by volume.
lee: I can spin a job to sample 2k examples stratified by intent+length. Do you want dedupe applied first?
anya: Yes — dedupe + exact-token hash ban for identicals. We still need to surface near-duplicates manually.
maria: For labeling, should we push everything to the normal golden labeling queue or create a temporary 'q8b-smoke' label campaign?
anya: Temporary campaign would be cleaner. Labelers should know this is regression-signal only and not normative. Tag: q8b-smoke.
labeler-ops-bot: @maria created campaign q8b-smoke (1500 tasks) assigned to "smoke-reviewers". ETA: 2d.
sam: Nice. Can we add metadata per sample: model_seed, decode_params, token_count, quant_profile so we can correlate?
lee: yep. I'll emit a CSV with columns: sample_id, prompt_hash, intent, length_bucket, model, quant_profile, decode, seed. Example CSV header:
```
sample_id,prompt_hash,intent,length_bucket,model,quant_profile,decode,seed
```
anya: Perfect. Also add a small quick-check script to auto-flag outputs with more than 30% token divergence from baseline model (franklin-fp16). That'll prioritize labeler review.
sam: Good idea. Quick pseudo:
```
# compute token overlap
overlap = overlap_tokens(baseline, q8b)
if overlap / baseline_tokens < 0.7:
    flag_for_labeling(sample_id, reason="low_overlap")
```
lee: I'll add the script to the job and run locally first. Expect first CSV by EOD.
maria: Labeling roster: prefer senior reviewers for the first 300 edgecases. I'll coordinate shift schedule.
anya: Thanks — once we have the first 300 labeled, let's run the eval harness and produce a short diff report: accuracy on instruction tasks, hallucination count, and code-safety regressions.
sam: Do we want to test quant profile variations? q8b-int4 vs q8b-int4-lcd (low-compute-density) etc?
anya: Yes — include both profiles in the sample, mark which profile generated it. Prioritize the one that will be default in Dedicated.
labeler-ops-bot: Campaign q8b-smoke updated: priority=high, reviewers=senior(3)/rotating(5), notes="regression-only: mark severity".
lee: Uploaded initial 500-sample CSV to s3://redwood-qa/q8b-smoke/initial.csv
anya: :thumbsup: I'll run the harness on those once labels start landing. If we see >5% regression on instruction accuracy or any critical hallucination, we stop the rollout.
sam: Copy. Will log results to the rollout ticket and update the canary strategy.
maria: Reminder: include a small set of adversarial prompts we previously used (adversarial-glue-100). Those caught the last hallucination cluster.
anya: Added to sampling pool. OK team — thanks, keep updates concise in this thread. :wave:
